title: What 7/10 Means as a Decimal
description: Filling in parts of a whole to see why 7/10 and 0.7 are the same amount.
narration_lines: What does seven tenths mean as a decimal?
Split a whole into 10 equal parts.
Now fill in 7 of those 10 parts.
Seven tenths is just 0.7 -- the tenths place is literally parts out of ten.
